messages:
martha-cs: Customer reported streaming resume produced partial + full output and got charged twice. They disconnected mid-stream (mobile flakey) then reconnected and received both a resumed tail and a new full generation. Billing shows two generation records.
leo-eng: rough customer id? logs?
martha-cs: org=acme-inc, convo id=conv_9482, initial session token s_tok=st_9a3, resume token r_tok=r_xyz. Attached their minimal repro: curl over SSE.
martha-cs: ```curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \n  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-xx","input":"write a short haiku about servers"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams```
irene-sre: can you paste the server-side stream events they saw? sequence numbers?
martha-cs: from customer logs (client shows SSE events):
```
event: chunk
data: {"seq":1,"text":"autumn servers sing\n"}

event: chunk
data: {"seq":2,"text":"cool air on the racks"}
event: partial
data: {"seq":3,"text":"leaves fall like"}

# connection lost, client reconnects and calls resume API with r_tok
event: resume_ack
data: {"resumed":true,"last_seq":3}

event: chunk
data: {"seq":3,"text":"leaves fall like"}
event: chunk
data: {"seq":4,"text":"soft hum in the night"}
```
martha-cs: note: customer got charged twice for the same generation (seq 3 onwards) in billing table: gen_778 and gen_779.
leo-eng: aha, seq 3 was re-sent and a new generation was also started server-side. Might be resume semantics mismatch: client sent resume token but server retried generation then streamed the replayed chunk instead of marking as replay-only.
irene-sre: did the client include an Idempotency-Key or conversation-level id?
martha-cs: customer says no. Mobile SDK doesn't attach idempotency by default on quick reconnect path.
leo-eng: reproduce steps for engineering: (1) open SSE, start generation; (2) drop connection after partial event; (3) reconnect with resume token; (4) immediately trigger a new request (race) from client fallback; should produce overlapping chunks and double billing.
leo-eng: put a repro script in node: ```js
// connect -> abort -> resume -> quick new request
// simulate race window <200ms
```
irene-sre: logs from server around the time? request ids?
martha-cs: server logs (redacted):
```
[12:34:01] req=rg_1 start stream gen_id=gen_778 seq_start=1
[12:34:03] conn lost for req=rg_1, resume_token=r_xyz
[12:34:03] resume_attempt for r_xyz -> spawn replay job gen_778_replay
[12:34:03] client fallback created new request req=rg_2 gen_id=gen_779
[12:34:03] gen_779 started (no idempotency key)
[12:34:04] replay emitted seq=3
[12:34:04] gen_779 emitted seq=3..4
```
leo-eng: so server started two separate generation runs: a replay job plus a fresh gen. We should ensure resume path does not create a fresh billable gen if resume is in progress or if last_seq can be replayed.
irene-sre: immediate mitigation: implement short server-side dedupe window keyed by resume_token + seq (or conversation id) to discard identical downstream billing when detected; and return a resume_ack that explicitly marks replay-only events as non-billable.
leo-eng: long-term: require clients to send Idempotency-Key for any new generation and add a Resume-If-Stalled header when reconnecting (server returns 409 or replay-only indication if resume is reclaiming).
martha-cs: customer wants rollback of duplicate charge for gen_779. Who owns billing ticket? @billing-team? :please: they sent invoice snapshot.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4122 -> Billing escalation, linked logs and billing ids gen_778,gen_779.
leo-eng: engineering action items:
- add guard: if resume_token active and replay job queued, reject new generation requests for same convo with 409 and reason=resume_in_progress (short window 5s)
- add server flag on streamed events \"billable\": true|false and ensure billing pipeline ignores events with billable=false
- return resume metadata: {resumed:true,last_seq:<n>,replay_mode:true} so clients can avoid re-requesting

irene-sre: add observability: metric resumed_replays, duplicate_gen_count, resume_conflicts. Alert if duplicate_gen_count > 1/min per org.
martha-cs: i've asked customer for logs and permission to refund. billing created ticket. Customer appreciates quick follow-up but wants a permanent client fix.
leo-eng: i'll draft a small server change and a mobile SDK PR to add idempotency on retry path. Patch target next week.
martha-cs: thanks all, will keep customer updated. :thumbsup:
